objectTypes.description: An entity whose time is allocated to activities
Complete time-bounded availability asserted by the authenticated user PA

exclusions.description: Only the explicitly selected event may be excluded after the PA verifies its calendar identity. Internal activity allocation still reserves that event time.

objectTypes.description: A user planning request and its time bounds

start.description: Inclusive beginning of the time interval

end.description: Exclusive end of the time interval

objectTypes.description: An activity assigned to resources over an explicit time interval

start.description: Inclusive beginning of the time interval

end.description: Exclusive end of the time interval

interfaceTypes.description: Calendar-backed planning: prepare a request through the PA, discover slots, and compare activities in scenarios.

linkTypes.description: The independently refreshable calendar coverage used by one planning request

functionTypes.description: Ask the original authenticated PA for complete calendar busy/available intervals, pause the same task if needed, and record a planning request with source availability. Credentials stay with the PA; no external calendar writes.
Find earliest feasible slots across all plan resources using current calendar availability and existing assignments, including scenario edits. Can exclude one existing activity when rescheduling.
Create or revise a time-bound activity and its resource/dependency Links. Scenario edits may contain conflicts for what-if comparison; live edits must satisfy scheduling constraints.
Remove an activity and its Links from the selected live or scenario view.
Evaluate window, resource, overlap and dependency constraints in the selected view. Missing, stale or incomplete calendar information is an error, never free time.
Return the current plan, its activities and freshly evaluated constraint results; scenarioId identifies isolated proposals. externalCalendarUpdated is always false.
Merge the exact reviewed scenario revision through an explicit PA Action, checking current calendar and resource constraints atomically. Does not create external calendar events.
